narrative.overview:
This system is the visual language of CryptoDash Pro's private Trade Bot console (`#trade-bot-page` only). The rest of the dashboard keeps its own chrome. The console is a night-charcoal operator panel: a bevelled command fascia, a column of process readouts, a recessed equity display, and recipe tabs under the bezel. RUN, STOP, and ESTOP are hardware keys. Numbers are instruments, not marketing tiles.

The material is painted steel and inset wells, not glass. Surfaces are olive-black plates with a hairline groove and a proud drop that reads as panel thickness. Color is a lamp, not a theme: green means live, amber means caution or held, red is the mushroom head and a losing sign. Everything else is beige legend on charcoal. Copy on this surface is Portuguese (pt-BR), set as stamped uppercase plates.

It refuses equal KPI cards, an icon-chip hero, nested rounded crypto-cards, and dashboard blue. Those belong to other pages.
keyCharacteristics: Night charcoal ground, olive bezel, deeper wells; beige legend and warm ink — not cool gray-on-blue.
Titillium Web for plates and keys; Red Hat Mono for values, stamps, and clocks.
Square plates (0 radius) with 2–3px only on keys and fields; circles only for the status lamp and the ESTOP mushroom.
Color reserved for lamp, P&L sign, side (LONG/SHORT), and the e-stop head.
Depth from inset wells and stacked bezel drops, never blur or floating cards.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Color is a lamp. If it is not the status lens, the RUN/STOP/ESTOP hardware, a P&L sign, or a LONG/SHORT side, it is charcoal, beige, or ink.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Titillium stamps the plate (name, tags, keys, tabs, titles). Red Hat Mono reports the process (values, sublines, uptime, pager, config numerics). Do not set a KPI in Titillium or a key caption in Mono.

rules.name: The Fascia-First Rule
rules.body: Status and kill live on the fascia. Tabs are recipe pages under the appliance, never a second hero and never a row of equal KPI cards above the fold.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: No blur, no floating soft shadow, no translucent frost. Depth is a pit or a proud bezel.

rules.name: The Square Panel Rule
rules.body: If it is a plate, it is square. If it is a lamp or a mushroom, it is a circle. Nothing else is a pill.

dos: Do put live/dead and open risk in the first glance: lamp + lead P&L/positions/drawdown, then RUN / STOP / ESTOP on the fascia.
Do keep color on lamps, signed numbers, side stamps, and the mushroom — Signal-Only Color Rule.
Do set values in Red Hat Mono tabular-nums and plates in uppercase Titillium — Two-Voice Rule.
Do bevel keys and let them travel on press; let the RUN key become the amber STOP face when held.
Do use square wells and a recessed display for recipe content under the fascia.
donts: Don't lay out equal KPI cards, an icon-chip hero, or nested rounded crypto-cards on this console.
Don't use dashboard blue, glass blur, pill radii, or soft floating shadows here.
Don't turn ESTOP into a red rectangular button or RUN into a text link.
Don't apply this HMI to the rest of CryptoDash Pro unless that surface is explicitly brought onto the panel.
Don't pulse, bounce, or fade recipe pages; the HMI kills those motions (`animation: none` on tabs and the running status dot).
